FIELDS.NAME: Precision Bind & Print Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Precision Bind & Print Solutions specializes in providing high-quality binderies and printing services, focusing on commercial clients such as publishers, educational institutions, and corporate entities. Our operations are entirely indoors and designed to meet stringent safety and regulatory standards, including effective fire safety measures and compliance with OSHA ventilation requirements. We utilize water-based or low-VOC inks to minimize environmental impact and ensure a safe working environment. Our production process includes thoroughly documented quality control procedures for all stages, from pre-press to finishing, which helps us maintain exceptional standards while mitigating risks associated with printing errors. Our trained personnel operate modern equipment with regular maintenance and inspection protocols in place, ensuring operational efficiency and safety. We are committed to robust risk management strategies and prioritize continuous improvement through regular audits and updates in safety and quality controls.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 12, 2022, a malfunction in the binding machine caused a loss of $3,500 due to equipment damage and operational downtime. This incident has been resolved, and the machine has since been repaired and is operational. Additionally, on May 5, 2022, a small fire triggered by an overheated printer resulted in a loss of $1,500, primarily due to material damage. No injuries occurred, and fire safety protocols were reviewed and updated.
FIELDS.Bodily Injury & Prop Damage Occurrrence: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate with a $1,000 deductible.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 2:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 1 - Fire Resistant, Grade A - Secure Storage for valuable documents and materials.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel on-site during operational hours; regular inspections and maintenance of fire safety systems.
